ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This site-based course is for EOL EdM and CAS students whose cohort began Sum 2008. The course begins Sep 19 and ends Dec 6. Class sessions will be held at the Oak Brook, Multi-University Center on the following four weekends: Sep 19 and 20, Oct 10 and 11, Nov 14 and 15, and Dec 5 and 6. The four Friday evening sessions will be held from 5:30 to 9:30 PM, and Saturday sessions will be held from 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to CAS:Educ Org & Leadershp -UIUC or EDM:Educ Org & Leadershp -UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $441.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $41.00 per Bill Hour.
